gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP reads steady and literary, its line faintly modulated. Comic Relief pushes against it with bold, twine-like strokes and bowls left open on one side, so the text serif feels restful beside it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-serif-kr: Noto Serif KR has wide s curves that barely curl inward. Over a longer stretch its mild thick-thin shifts smooth the reading pace, with no harsh hairlines, while Comic Relief up top keeps every letter uniform.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-serif-sc: Noto Serif SC rounds its letters and thickens them slightly at the sides, with openings you can see through. Noto Serif SC handles the quiet weight shifts from stem to serif, while Comic Relief draws a flat fineliner line that suits bold display work.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-serif-tc: Glowing like neon tubing, Comic Relief draws every letter at a single line thickness, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Noto Serif TC does the opposite job: stems and hairlines differ only modestly.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-petrona: Marker-drawn and blunt, Comic Relief hits hard. Petrona answers over a longer passage with a text serif drawn by a barely tilted nib, its shallow curls and tempered contrast never jolting the eye.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-poly: Comic Relief has a pipe-cleaner look, bold strokes with bowls left open on one side. And Poly, a classic serif, adds a slight swell on its bowls and pulled-back terminals, giving the page a bookish counterweight.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-quattrocento: Quattrocento is a classic serif whose horizontal strokes run slightly slimmer than its verticals, leaving visible daylight inside every curve. Beside Comic Relief's uniform strokes, its varied weights feel alive.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-radley: Authoritative is the mood Radley brings, with counters the eye slips through and sturdy downstrokes. Radley is the serif for reading, while Comic Relief earns its keep big and short, its stems matching hairlines because it has none.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-roboto-serif: Roboto Serif reads classic and dignified, with big open eyes on its e and a and generous spacing between letters. Roboto Serif gives the smooth, pen-plotter lines of Comic Relief a soft, brush-like partner below.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-sahitya: Pipe-cleaner letters, bold and bendy. Sahitya, a text serif, takes over for longer reading, its thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick ones and its s and c left open and uncrowded.
